name: Aperio iCal Feed
author: Aperio Contributors
description: Bundled read-only calendar adapter for .ics-feed URLs — public calendars, hosted .ics files, share links from Google/Apple/iCloud.

en.account.feed_url.hint: Public .ics URL. Read-only — events from this feed cannot be edited in Aperio.
en.account.feed_url.label: Feed URL
en.account.password.hint: Leave blank unless the feed asks for one. Stored only in your operating system's credential store.
en.account.password.label: Password (optional)
en.account.username.hint: Only fill in if the feed requires HTTP Basic auth. Public feeds stay anonymous.
en.account.username.label: Username (optional)

de.account.feed_url.hint: Öffentliche .ics-Adresse. Lesezugriff — Termine aus diesem Feed können in Aperio nicht bearbeitet werden.
de.account.feed_url.label: Feed-URL
de.account.password.hint: Leer lassen, wenn der Feed keines verlangt. Das Passwort wird nur im Anmeldeinformations-Manager des Betriebssystems gespeichert.
de.account.password.label: Passwort (optional)
de.account.username.hint: Nur ausfüllen, wenn der Feed Basic-Auth verlangt. Öffentliche Feeds bleiben anonym.
de.account.username.label: Benutzername (optional)
